hook: Rodney Brooks trained in pure mathematics at Flinders University in his native Australia before earning a PhD in computer science from Stanford in 1981. After research positions at Carnegie Mellon, MIT and Stanford, he joined the MIT faculty in 1984 and later directed the MIT Artificial Intelligence Laboratory and then the Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. His 1986 paper describing the subsumption architecture argued that intelligent robot behavior could emerge from layered, reactive control systems rather than centralized symbolic planning, a challenge to the AI orthodoxy of the time that helped found the field of behavior-based robotics. He put that thinking into commercial practice by co-founding iRobot in 1990 with Colin Angle and Helen Greiner, whose Roomba vacuum became one of the first robots to reach mass consumer markets. In 2008 he founded Heartland Robotics, later renamed Rethink Robotics, to build the Baxter and Sawyer collaborative robots for factory work, and in 2019 he founded Robust.AI to continue work on practical, everyday robotics.

quick_facts: Co-founded iRobot in 1990 with Colin Angle and Helen Greiner, whose Roomba became one of the first mass-market home robots
Founded Heartland Robotics in 2008, later renamed Rethink Robotics, maker of the Baxter and Sawyer collaborative robots
Developed the subsumption architecture, a layered, behavior-based approach to robot control described in his 1986 paper A Robust Layered Control System for a Mobile Robot
Served as director of the MIT Artificial Intelligence Laboratory from 1997 to 2003 and then the MIT Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory from 2003 to 2007
Holds the title of Panasonic Professor of Robotics at MIT
Founded Robust.AI in 2019 to continue research on practical robotics

achievements.title: Subsumption architecture
achievements.impact: Introduced a layered, behavior-based approach to robot control that let simple reactive systems produce complex behavior without centralized planning, reshaping how the field designs autonomous robots.

achievements.title: Co-founder of iRobot
achievements.impact: Helped build one of the first robotics companies to succeed commercially at scale, bringing autonomous robots like the Roomba into ordinary homes.

achievements.title: Founder of Rethink Robotics
achievements.impact: Built collaborative robots designed to work safely alongside people on factory floors, advancing human-robot collaboration in manufacturing.

achievements.title: Director, MIT AI Lab and CSAIL
achievements.impact: Led one of the world's leading artificial intelligence research labs through its merger into the Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory.
